The backend calls this method to emit a notice while processing an advance-state request.
A notice is a statement about the application state that anyone can validate on the base layer, through the application contract's `validateOutput()` function, once the claim of its epoch has been accepted.

The response holds the index of the new output among all the outputs the application has emitted.
